_comment: Which userscripts we attribute MusicBrainz edits to, and how.
Attribution is purely by edit-note text. Every script in this repo stamps its
notes with a header built as `<name> v<version> by <author> - <homepage>`, e.g.
so `userscripts/<slug>` is a unique, stable discriminator: it appears in every
note the script writes and never collides between scripts.
`patterns` are plain substrings (not regexes) matched against the raw note text.
Any one of them matching attributes the note to that script. The matching
pattern is recorded per note, so mis-attribution is diagnosable in SQL.
The full note text is stored in the database. That is deliberate: re-attributing
or re-parsing versions later is then a local SQL exercise instead of another
`owner` splits 'my scripts' from third-party ones used for comparison. The
`note` flags scripts that may legitimately produce zero edits (read-only
analysers that annotate but never submit) so a 0 is not read as a bug.
_default_cutoff: Where the dashboard's date filter starts, not what is ingested — all history is captured regardless, so widening this needs only a report re-run. Set to the month our scripts actually start (2026-05, 12,766 edits) so the default view carries no empty leading months.
_default_version_regex: Deliberately loose. Most scripts stamp '<Name> v<version> by <author> - <url>', but Group Therapy writes '<Name> by <author> v<version> - <url>', so anchoring on a trailing ' by ' silently lost 38,575 versions. Matching whitespace + v + digit handles both orders.
_owner_mb_username: The repo author's MusicBrainz account. The dashboard's 'exclude the author' toggle keys off this, so adoption can be read as 'other people using it'.

scripts.name: Import Discogs Credits
scripts._merge_into: Parallel twin of Credit Hoarder, same tool from a different entry point, so the reports count them as one. This is a presentation-level merge: both are still stored separately, so dropping this line and re-running the reports splits them again without touching the dump.

scripts.name: Mammoth
scripts.note: mostly annotates edit notes; may submit few edits of its own

scripts.name: String Theory
scripts.note: bundle loader; edits are normally attributed to the member script that made them

scripts.name: Bandcamp Player Enhanced
scripts.note: Bandcamp-side player; does not submit MusicBrainz edits

scripts.name: Harmony
scripts.note: kellnerd's importer. Seeds notes as 'Imported with Harmony (<url>), using data from:' — it carries no version, so version stats stay empty.

scripts.name: Enhanced Cover Art Uploads
scripts.note: ROpdebee's ECAU footer is '<name> <version>\n<namespace>', and the namespace is the shared repo URL — so this pattern also catches ROpdebee's other userscripts. The stored note text lets us split them apart in SQL without a re-run.
